SUBJECT:
Complaint lodged with Mayor of Greater Shanghai
by Mr. Lomin, Chairman of the Central Charity
Committee of Russian Emigrants' Committee.

From perusal of the attached file, as well as
from personal knowledge of the subject, it is quite
clear that:-

1) In ordering the dissolution of the Central
Charity Committee, Mr. Leboff, Chairman of the
Russian Emigrants' Committee acted strictly
within limits of the authority with which he is
vested by the Statute of the Russian Emigrants'
Committee sanctioned by Mayor of Greater
Shanghai on November 11th., 1941. Moreover
General Leboff's action was fully endorsed
by the Emigrants' Committee and by representa-
tives of almost all charitable organizations
of the emigrants community.

2). Taking over by the Russian Emigrants' Committee
of the property which was under temporary
management of the dissolved organization, took
place with the sanction of the authorised local
representative of the legal owner of the property
in question.

3). The natural question of taking over and/or
proper regulating of the various liabilities
which the dissolved organization might have at
the time of taking over of property from its
charge, is at present receiving due consideration
by a committee appointed specially for this
purpose and comprised of an equal number of
representatives of the parties concerned.

4). Not only no disruption of relief work resulted
from dissolution of the Central Charity Commit-
tee but there is every reason to expect its
extension and improvement.

（左侧手写签名）

事由：
俄侨委员会中央慈善委员会主席洛明（Lomin）先生向大上海市长提出的投诉。

通过审阅附件卷宗，以及基于本人对该事项的了解，情况十分清楚：-

1) 俄侨委员会主席列博夫（Leboff）先生在下令解散中央慈善委员会时，严格在其职权范围内行事，该职权系由大上海市长于1941年11月11日批准的《俄侨委员会章程》所赋予。此外，格列博夫（Gleboff）将军的行动得到了俄侨委员会以及俄侨社区几乎所有慈善组织代表的充分认可。

2). 俄侨委员会接管原已解散组织临时管理的财产，是在该财产合法所有人的授权当地代表批准下进行的。

3). 关于在接管财产时，如何处理和/或适当规管被解散组织可能存在的各种债务这一自然产生的问题，目前正由一个专门为此目的成立的委员会予以适当考虑，该委员会由有关各方同等数量的代表组成。

4). 中央慈善委员会的解散不仅未导致救济工作中断，而且有充分理由预期救济工作将得到扩展和改善。

（左侧手写签名）

Foreign Affairs, S.M.
APRIL 24 ,1945

SUBJECT:- Complaint lodged with Mayor of Greater Shang-
hai by Chairman of Central Charity Committee
against Chairman of Russian Emigrants Com-
mittee.

本件歸檔備查

In conformity with instructions contained in Order
No.2478 dated March 31,1945 of Shanghai Special Municipality Go-
vernment,enquiries have been made into the conflict between the
Russian Emigrants Committee and a Russian organization known as
"Central Charity Committee",which forms the subject of the at-
tached complaint lodged with Mayor of Greater Shanghai by Mr.
N.U. FOMIN,Chairman of the latter organization, against Mr.F.L.
GLEBOFF,Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee.

In order to obtain a clear understanding of the origin
and nature of the conflict in question,it is necessary to keep
in view the following facts relating to public life of the lo-
cal Russian emigrant community:-

During the period from 1926 to the time of establish-
ment of the present National Government of the Republic of China
the Russian emigrant community in Shanghai never had a central
representative and administrative organ,recognized as such by
all the authorities concerned,as well as by the entire Russian
emigrant community. All efforts made in order to effect unity
in this respect proved to have been unsuccessful,which may be
mainly attributed to the following factors:-

(a) inability of leading public organizations to
come to an understanding as to the principles,
in accordance with which the representative and
administrative organ of the community should
be constituted;

(b) Existence in Shanghai of three administrative
areas controlled by entirely independent autho-
rities,which state of affairs presented a fa-
vourable soil for various separatist tendencies
in the community.

As a result of the above circumstances there existed in
Shanghai at the time of outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities
in 1937 two rival public bodies,both claiming the status of
central representative and administrative organ of the Russian
emigrant community,namely: "Council of United Russian Public Or-
ganization" (established in 1932) under chairmanship of F.L.
GLEBOFF and " Russian Emigrants' Association in Shanghai" (es-

事由：- 中央慈善委员会主席针对俄侨委员会主席向大上海市长提出的投诉。

本件归档备查

根据1945年3月31日上海特别市政府第2478号命令中的指示，已对俄侨委员会与一个名为“中央慈善委员会”的俄人组织之间的冲突进行了调查，该冲突即为后一组织主席N.U. 福明（FOMIN）先生针对俄侨委员会主席F.L. 格列博夫（GLEBOFF）先生向大上海市长提交的附呈投诉之主题。

为了清楚地了解上述冲突的起源和性质，有必要关注以下与当地俄侨社区公共生活相关的事实：-

从1926年到中华民国现国民政府成立期间，上海的俄侨社区从未拥有一个被所有有关当局以及整个俄侨社区公认的中央代表和行政机构。所有旨在实现这方面统一的努力均证明 unsuccessful（不成功），这主要归因于以下因素：-

(a) 主要公共组织无法就社区代表和行政机构的组建原则达成共识；

(b) 上海存在三个由完全独立的当局控制的行政区域，这种状态为社区内的各种分离主义倾向提供了有利的土壤。

由于上述情况，在1937年中日敌对行动爆发时，上海存在两个相互竞争的公共机构，均声称拥有俄侨社区中央代表和行政机构的地位，即：由F.L. 格列博夫（GLEBOFF）担任主席的“俄罗斯公共组织联合理事会”（成立于1932年）和“上海俄侨协会”（成

tablished on 8-4-35). The latter, in turn, was comprised of two
bodies:-
(a) "Russian Emigrants Committee" (established in
1926), which carried out representative and no-
tary functions under chairmanship of Mr. C.E.
METZLER
(b) "National Committee" (established on 8-4-35),
which dealt with internal affairs of the com-
munity, including charitable activities, un-
der chairmanship of Mr. N.U. FOMIN.

In April, 1938 the Japanese and the new local Chinese autho-
rities recognized the Russian Emigrants Committee, in a reorga-
nized form, as the only organ for administration of the commu-
nity. In September of the same year, owing to a discord between
Messrs METZLER and FOMIN, the Russian Emigrants Committee seve-
red its connections with the "Russian Emigrants' Association in
Shanghai". On May 30, 1939 the City Government of Shanghai in-
serted a notice in all local Russian newspapers to the effect
that all, without exception, organizations of Russian emigrants
in Shanghai must be registered at the Russian Emigrants Commit-
tee. Failing to comply with this notice, Mr. FOMIN announced on
June 12, 1939 that both the "Russian Emigrants' Association in
Shanghai" and its organ - the "National Committee" had ceased
to exist and that only Charity Section of the "National Com-
mittee" would continue to function "in a state of liquidation"
until further notice.
As to the "Council of United Russian Organization", it went
out of existence without any announcement to that effect.

Under late Mr. N.A. IVANOFF, Mr. Metzler's successor at the
post of Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee, a representa-
tive of Charity Section of the former National Committee was,
on 18-9-40, included in Governing Board of the Russian Emi-
grants Committee. Later on, the question of centralization of
all charitable activities was again raised on June 11, 1941 at
a meeting of Charity Section of the former "National Committee"
attended by Head of Russian Orthodox Mission in China and by
Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee. It was decided to
abolish the Charity Section of former "National Committee" and
to establish a new organization under the name of "Central Cha-
rity Committee of Russian Emigrant Community in Shanghai". All
duties, rights and property of the abolished organization were
taken over by the newly created one and all members of the for-
mer were automatically included in the latter retaining in it
the respective posts they had held in the abolished organiza-
tion. Thus Mr. N.U. FOMIN became chairman of the Central Cha-
rity Committee.
The new organization was registered with the Russian Emi-
grants Committee, but was given independence in the matter of

(a) “俄侨委员会”（成立于1926年），在C.E. 梅茨勒（METZLER）先生主持下履行代表和公证职能；
(b) “全国委员会”（成立于1935年4月8日），在N.U. 福明（FOMIN）先生主持下处理社区内部事务，包括慈善活动。

1938年4月，日本人和当地新的中国当局承认改组后的俄侨委员会为管理社区的唯一机构。同年9月，由于梅茨勒（METZLER）和福明（FOMIN）两位先生之间的不和，俄侨委员会切断了与“上海俄侨协会”的联系。1939年5月30日，上海市政府在所有当地俄文报纸上刊登公告，称在上海的所有俄侨组织，无一例外，必须在俄侨委员会注册。福明（FOMIN）先生未能遵守此公告，并于1939年6月12日宣布，“上海俄侨协会”及其机构——“全国委员会”已停止存在，只有“全国委员会”的慈善部将在“清算状态”下继续运作，直至另行通知。
至于“俄罗斯组织联合理事会”，它在未发布任何此类公告的情况下不复存在。

在已故的N.A. 伊万诺夫（IVANOFF）先生（梅茨勒先生的继任者，担任俄侨委员会主席）任内，前全国委员会慈善部的代表于1940年9月18日被纳入俄侨委员会的管理董事会。后来，关于集中所有慈善活动的问题再次于1941年6月11日在前“全国委员会”慈善部会议上提出，出席会议的有在华俄罗斯东正教传教团团长和俄侨委员会主席。会议决定废除前“全国委员会”的慈善部，并建立一个名为“上海俄侨社区中央慈善委员会”的新组织。被废除组织的所有职责、权利和财产均由新成立的组织接管，前组织的所有成员自动加入新组织，并保留其在被废除组织中担任的相应职务。因此，N.U. 福明（FOMIN）先生成为中央慈善委员会主席。

On November 25, 1941 was published in local Russian press
the "Statute of Russian Emigrants Committee" approved by mayor
of Greater Shanghai on November 8, 1941 and registered with the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai under No. 14373. According to
this Statute, which is still in force at present, "all Russian
emigrants residing in Shanghai, as well as all institutions and
organizations formed and administered by Russian emigrants, are
subordinated to the Russian Emigrants Committee", Chairman of
which "directs the activities of the Committee and is respon-
sible for these activities". While Clause 6 of the Statute, in
which the various sections of the Committee are enumerated, con-
tains no mention of Charity Section, Clause 9 stipulates that
"the entire charitable activities in the Russian emigrant com-
munity are subject to control on the part of the Russian Emi-
grants Committee".
Thus, for the first time since 1926 the local Russian emi-
grant community was placed under one central administrative or-
gan functioning under general control of and responsible to the
local authorities.

On April 25, 1942 by a resolution of the Russian Emigrants
Committee (Chairman - Mr. N.K. SEREJNIKOFF) Mr. M.U. FOMIN,
Chairman of Central Charity Committee, was included in the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee with the status of Chief of Charity Sec-
tion. From that time all members of the Central Charity Committee
have been made subject to approval by the Russian Emigrants Com-
mittee.

The formation of Central Charity Committee as an organiza-
tion functioning separately and, to a certain extent, independent-
ly from the Russian Emigrants Committee, was explained by the fol-
lowing circumstances:
Russian charities in Shanghai were largely dependent on
help received from local foreign charitable institutions. However,
in view of the fact that rather tense relations existed at that
time between the new local Chinese authorities and the authori-
ties of the two former foreign settlements, foreign charitable
institutions did not favour the Russian Emigrants Committee - an
organization functioning under direct control of the Chinese and
Japanese authorities. Formation of the Central Charity Committee
may be regarded as practical solution of this problem, and it has
served its purpose.
At present the general situation in Shanghai is entirely
different: no help is received by Russian organizations from fo-
reign sources, while the entire area of Shanghai is controlled by
the Chinese authorities. Consequently, complete centralization
of public work in the community may be affected at any time, when
it is deemed necessary and expedient to do so.

1941年11月25日，当地俄文报刊刊登了由大上海市长于1941年11月8日批准、并在大上海市政府以第14373号注册的《俄国侨民委员会章程》。根据该章程（目前仍然有效），“所有居住在上海的俄国侨民，以及由俄国侨民组建和管理的所有机构和组织，均隶属于俄国侨民委员会”，其主席“指导委员会的活动并对这些活动负责”。虽然章程第6条列举了委员会的各个部门，其中并未提及慈善部，但第9条规定，“俄国侨民社区内的所有慈善活动均受俄国侨民委员会的控制”。

因此，自1926年以来，当地俄国侨民社区首次被置于一个中央行政机构之下，该机构在当地当局的总体控制下运作并对其负责。

1942年4月25日，经俄国侨民委员会（主席为N.K. SEREJNIKOFF先生）决议，中央慈善委员会主席M.U. FOMIN先生以慈善部主任的身份加入俄国侨民委员会。从那时起，中央慈善委员会的所有成员均需经俄国侨民委员会批准。

中央慈善委员会作为一个独立于俄国侨民委员会、且在某种程度上独立运作的组织的成立，是由以下情况所致：
上海的俄国慈善机构在很大程度上依赖于从当地外国慈善机构获得的援助。然而，鉴于当时新的中国地方当局与前两个外国租界当局之间存在相当紧张的关系，外国慈善机构并不青睐俄国侨民委员会——这是一个在中国和日本当局直接控制下运作的组织。成立中央慈善委员会可被视为解决这一问题的实际方案，且已达到了其目的。
目前，上海的总体形势已完全不同：俄国组织不再从外国来源获得任何援助，而整个上海地区均由中国当局控制。因此，一旦认为有必要且适宜，随时可以实现社区公共工作的完全集中化。

On 1-1-43 the post of Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee was assumed by Mr. F.L. GLEBOFF's. In April,1944 he carried out a reorganization of the Committee with a view to transforming it from a purely administrative organ in an organ built up on a public basis. For this purpose three public bodies were elected by representatives of the various organizations,namely: Emigrants Committee, Supervision & Control Commission and Arbitration Court. From that time the Emigrants Committee - the highest organ of the community - is comprised of 14 members: 8 by election and 6 by appointment,the latter group consisting of chiefs of the various sections of the Emigrants Committee. By virtue of the fact that Mr. N.U. FOMIN carried out the duties of Chief of Charity Section, he also was given the status of member of the Committee.

During the course of the second half of 1944 the Supervision & Control Commission of the Russian Emigrants Committee began ,in execution of its proper duties, an inspection of the various Russian charitable organizations and institutions,their activities and accounts. It was in connection with this inspection that serious friction arose between the Russian Emigrants Committee and FOMIN's Central Charity Committee.

Apart from its duties in connection with representation of Russian charitable organizations and,to a certain extent,coordination of their activities, the Central Charity Committee for several years operated the so-called Russian Public Dining Hut, 79/A Route de Say Zoeng,where meals are issued to the poorer class of the emigrant community at reduced price,or free of charge. The Hut was constructed in 1938 at the cost of $7,000,of which sum $4000 was donated by foreign charities and $3,000 subscribed by members of the Russian community. The piece of land,on which the hut is located ( Mun. Lot No.F.C. 854/10035 ), was bought in 1941 for the sum of $42,950 from Mr. A. Loonis for the needs of Russian emigrant community, Mr. N.U. FOMIN being instrumental in obtaining very easy terms of payment,as well as in obtaining from French charities a loan of $10,000 for initial payment. For the rest of the sum involved an obligation was signed by Messrs N.A. IVANOFF, Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee, and N.U.FOMIN. Both the loan and the rest of the sum with interest were subsequently paid by the Russian Emigrants Committee,the final payment being made in 1944. For the sake of convenience the land was registered in the name of the Russian Orthodox Mission in China, and head of the Mission issued a Letter of Trust in the name of Messrs N.A. IVANOFF and N.U. FOMIN. On 15-5-43 a new Letter of Trust was issued by head of the Mission,this time in the name of N.U. FOMIN and Father M. KOGOJIN,local representative of the Mission.

Pointing out that Agreement dated 11-6-41 regarding formation of the Central Charity Committee stipulates independence of the latter in financial matters,as well as in management of its property ( Dining Hut etc ), Mr. FOMIN raised objection to the in-

1943年1月1日，F.L. GLEBOFF先生就任俄国侨民委员会主席一职。1944年4月，他对委员会进行了改组，旨在将其从一个纯粹的行政机构转变为一个建立在公共基础上的机构。为此，由各组织代表选举产生了三个公共机构，即：侨民委员会、监察与控制委员会以及仲裁法庭。从那时起，作为社区最高机构的侨民委员会由14名成员组成：8名经选举产生，6名经任命产生，后者由侨民委员会各部门主任组成。鉴于N.U. FOMIN先生履行慈善部主任的职责，他也获得了委员会成员的身份。

在1944年下半年期间，俄国侨民委员会的监察与控制委员会开始执行其正当职责，对各类俄国慈善组织和机构及其活动和账目进行检查。正是在这次检查过程中，俄国侨民委员会与FOMIN领导的中央慈善委员会之间发生了严重的摩擦。

除了代表俄国慈善组织以及在一定程度上协调其活动的职责外，中央慈善委员会多年来还运营着所谓的“俄国公共食堂”，地址为霞飞路（Route de Say Zoeng）79/A号，以低价或免费向侨民社区中的贫困阶层提供餐食。该食堂建于1938年，耗资7,000美元，其中4,000美元由外国慈善机构捐赠，3,000美元由俄国社区成员认购。食堂所在的地块（市政地块编号 F.C. 854/10035）于1941年以42,950美元的价格从A. Loonis先生处购买，用于俄国侨民社区的需要，N.U. FOMIN先生在争取非常宽松的付款条件以及从法国慈善机构获得10,000美元贷款作为首付款方面发挥了重要作用。剩余款项由俄国侨民委员会主席N.A. IVANOFF先生和N.U. FOMIN先生签署欠条。随后，俄国侨民委员会支付了这笔贷款及剩余款项连同利息，最后一笔款项于1944年付清。为了方便起见，土地登记在中国东正教传教团名下，传教团团长向N.A. IVANOFF先生和N.U. FOMIN先生出具了一份信托函。1943年5月15日，传教团团长签发了一份新的信托函，此次是发给N.U. FOMIN先生和传教团当地代表M. KOGOJIN神父。

指出关于成立中央慈善委员会的1941年6月11日协议规定了后者在财务事项及其财产（食堂等）管理方面的独立性，FOMIN先生对监...

tention of the Supervising & Controll Commission to carry out full
examination of affairs and accounts of his Committee.
Apart from being an act savouring of insubordination to the
Russian Migrants Committee, Mr. FOMIN's attitude in this case was
rather unfortunate in view of the fact that rumours had been cir-
culating in the community alleging the existence of certain irre-
gularities in the management of affairs of the Central Charity Com-
mittee. Mr. FOMIN was aware of these rumours ( which, it should be
noted, had no reflection on his good name and reputation ), but for
reasons better known to himself he did not wish to disprove all the
allegations by allowing the Supervision & Controll Commission to
carry out the examination in question.
In connection with this friction it is of interest to note
that on 24-10-44 the Russian Migrants Committee passed a resolu-
tion to the effect that agreement dated 11-6-41 referred to by
Mr. FOMIN had lost its significance and force following publication
of statute of Russian Migrants Committee approved by Mayor of Grea-
ter Shanghai on 5-11-41.

Following his re-election as Chairman of the Russian Mi-
grants Committee for 1945, Mr. GLASOFF proceeded with the carrying
into effect of his plan of organization of economic self-aid in
the community, the necessity of which had for some time been stres-
sed in all public circles of the community. For this purpose he
formed, on 30-1-45, the "Special Economic Council of Russian Emi-
grant Community in Shanghai" functioning under his chairmanship
and comprised of 20 businessmen, of whom 18 were appointed by him
and 2 were delegated by the Russian and Jewish Chambers of Com-
merce. According to Mr. GLASOFF's instructions, the first task
of the Council was to raise amongst the well-to-do class of the
community sufficient funds ( ¥50,000,000 was mentioned as maxi-
mum ), out of which various forms of relief to the poorer classes
of the community were to be financed. It was then decided that
in the first place supply of meals at cost price, reduced prices
or free of charge should be organized for the poorer classes of
the Russian community.

Naturally, the Public Dining Hut was first to be used for
this purpose, as it only required extension of the work it was
already carrying out. Accordingly, early in February last Mr.
GLASOFF instructed Mr. FOMIN to put the Dining Hut at the dis-
posal of the Special Economic Council for an indefinite period.
Welcoming, in principle, the plan of extending the work of the
Hut, Mr. FOMIN and his Committee again raised the point of status
of the Central Charity Committee, as one of the three parties sig-
natory to Agreement of 11-6-41 and also the question of ownership
of the premises of the Hut and of the land where it is located.
They suggested a lease of part of the premises in question on
certain conditions to be agreed upon by the parties concerned.

In view of this attitude of the Central Charity Committee
Mr. GLASOFF on 23-2-45 ordered dissolution of that Committee,

...察与控制委员会全面审查其委员会事务和账目的意图提出了异议。
FOMIN先生在此事上的态度不仅带有不服从俄国侨民委员会的性质，而且鉴于社区内流传着关于中央慈善委员会事务管理存在某些违规行为的谣言，这种做法也是相当不幸的。FOMIN先生知晓这些谣言（值得注意的是，这些谣言并未损害他的良好名声和声誉），但出于只有他自己清楚的原因，他不希望通过允许监察与控制委员会进行上述审查来反驳所有指控。
鉴于此次摩擦，值得注意的是，1944年10月24日，俄国侨民委员会通过了一项决议，指出FOMIN先生所引用的1941年6月11日协议，在大上海市长于1941年11月5日批准的《俄国侨民委员会章程》公布后，已失去其意义和效力。

在再次当选为1945年度俄国侨民委员会主席后，GLASOFF先生着手实施其在社区内组织经济自救的计划，社区的各个公共圈子长期以来一直强调这一计划的必要性。为此，他于1945年1月30日成立了“上海俄国侨民社区特别经济委员会”，由他担任主席，成员包括20名商人，其中18名由他任命，2名由俄国和犹太商会委派。根据GLASOFF先生的指示，委员会的首要任务是在社区的富裕阶层中筹集足够的资金（提到的最高金额为5,000万法币），用于资助针对社区贫困阶层的各种形式的救济。随后决定，首先应为俄国社区的贫困阶层组织按成本价、减价或免费供应餐食。

自然，公共食堂首先被用于此目的，因为它只需扩展其已经在开展的工作。因此，去年2月初，GLASOFF先生指示FOMIN先生将食堂无限期地交由特别经济委员会支配。FOMIN先生及其委员会原则上欢迎扩展食堂工作的计划，但再次提出中央慈善委员会的地位问题，作为1941年6月11日协议的三方签署方之一，同时也提出了食堂房屋及其所在土地的所有权问题。他们建议在有关各方商定的某些条件下，租赁部分相关房屋。

鉴于中央慈善委员会的这种态度，GLASOFF先生于1945年2月23日下令解散该委员会，

while Mr. FOMIN was retained to direct activities of all charitable
organizations in the community in the capacity of Chief of Charity
Section of Russian Emigrants Committee.

Mr. GLASOFF's action was subsequently fully endorsed by the
Russian Emigrants Committee in resolutions passed on 27-2-45 and
13-3-45, respectively, as well as by representatives of 17, out of
total number of 22 emigrant charitable organizations, who attended
a special meeting of the Emigrants Committee convened on 27-3-45.

Maintaining their viewpoint, Mr. FOMIN and his Committee de-
clared Mr. GLASOFF's action, as well as resolutions passed by the
Emigrants Committee and representatives of charitable organizations
"illegal" or "inconsistent with law" and finally flatly refused to
comply with the order in question pending arrival in Shanghai from
Peking of Archbishop Victor, head of Russian Orthodox Mission in
China.

Meanwhile, the Special Economic Council had to proceed with
his work of organization of supply of hot meals to needy members
of the community at another place, namely, at 1260 Rue Lafayette, be-
ginning these activities on March 22, 1945.

From the particulars outlined above, as well as from perusal
of Mr. FOMIN's complaint and of the correspondence that took place
between him and Russian Emigrants Committee in connection with this
matter, it would appear that the essential points of the dispute in
question are as follows:-

1. Viewpoint of Central Charity Committee,
chairman Mr. M.U. FOMIN.

(a) Central Charity Committee was established by virtue of
Protocol signed on 11-0-41 by three parties: Archbishop VICTOR,
Head of Russian Orthodox Mission in China; N.A. IVANOFF, then Chair-
man of Russian Emigrants Committee; M.U. FOMIN, Chairman, and members
of Charity Section of former "National Committee".

(b) The Protocol stipulated independence of the C.C. Committee
in financial matters and in management of its property.

(c) This arrangement was kept in view when the Statute of
Russian Emigrants Committee, approved by Mayor of Greater Shanghai on
8-11-41, was drafted, as it contains no mention of Charity Section in
the Constitution of the Committee.

(d) The C.C. Committee is located at 79/A Route de Say Zoong,
both premises (Public Dining Hut ) and land being property of Rus-

-6-

同时保留FOMIN先生，以俄国侨民委员会慈善部主任的身份指导社区内所有慈善组织的活动。

GLASOFF先生的行动随后得到了俄国侨民委员会在1945年2月27日和3月13日分别通过的决议的充分认可，同时也得到了出席1945年3月27日召开的侨民委员会特别会议的22个侨民慈善组织中的17个代表的认可。

坚持其观点，FOMIN先生及其委员会宣布GLASOFF先生的行动以及侨民委员会和慈善组织代表通过的决议“非法”或“不符合法律”，并最终断然拒绝遵守相关命令，等待中国东正教传教团团长维克多大主教（Archbishop Victor）从北平抵达上海。

与此同时，特别经济委员会不得不在另一地点，即拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1260号，继续开展向社区 needy 成员供应热食的组织工作，并于1945年3月22日开始这些活动。

从上述细节，以及通过审阅FOMIN先生的申诉书和他与俄国侨民委员会就此事宜进行的往来信件，可以看出，当前争议的核心要点如下：-

1. 中央慈善委员会的观点，
主席 M.U. FOMIN 先生。

(a) 中央慈善委员会是根据1941年[原文为11-0-41，疑为11月或10月]由三方签署的议定书成立的：中国东正教传教团团长维克多大主教（Archbishop VICTOR）；时任俄国侨民委员会主席的N.A. IVANOFF；前“全国委员会”慈善部主席M.U. FOMIN及其成员。

(b) 该议定书规定了中央慈善委员会在财务事项及其财产管理方面的独立性。

(c) 在起草1941年11月8日由大上海市长批准的《俄国侨民委员会章程》时，考虑到了这一安排，因为章程中并未提及慈善部。

(d) 中央慈善委员会位于霞飞路（Route de Say Zoong）79/A号，房屋（公共食堂）和土地均为俄...

sian Orthodox Mission in China. Archbishop VICTOR (Peking),Head
of the Mission,issued a Letter of Trust in respect of the proper-
ty to N.U.FOMIN,Chairman of C.C.Committee, and Father M.ROGOJIN,
the Mission's local representative.

(e) F.L.GLEBOFF,Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee, order-
ed N.U.FOMIN to hand over the Public Dining Room to the newly or-
ganized "Special Economic Council" and to dissolve the C.C.Commit-
tee. He made N.U. FOMIN personally responsible for the carrying
out of this order. However, N.U. FOMIN,in his capacity of one of
the Trustees,cannot hand over the Mission's property without au-
thority from Archbishop VICTOR,the Truster. He also cannot dis-
solve the C.C.Committee without having first lawfully regulated
all liabilities and obligations he has on hand in his capacity of
Chairman of the C.C.Committee.

(f) Dissolution of the C.C.Committee will mean disruption of
extensive charity work carried out by this organization; loss of
a monthly income of about $1,000,000 for charity purposes of the
emigrant community,this sum being earned by efforts of the C.C.
Committee at present and,further, it will mean immediate distress
to some 50 employees of the C.C.Committee and to some 100 people
receiving relief from the C.C.Committee at present.

II. Viewpoint of Russian Emigrants Committee,
Chairman F.L. GLEBOFF.

(a) By virtue of Statute of Russian Emigrants Committee ap-
proved by Mayor of Greater Shanghai on 9-11-41, Russian Emigrants
Committee is an administrative organ,to which all Russian emi-
grants residing in Shanghai and all their organizations are sub-
ordinated. Chairman of the R.E. Committee directs its activities
and is responsible for them.

(b) Following publication of the Statute,Protocol dated
11-6-41 regarding formation of Central Charity Committee lost its
binding force.

(c) Although no mention is made in the Statute of Charity
Section in the constitution of the R.E.Committee,Clause 9 stipu-
lates that that the entire charitable activities in the emigrant
community is subject to control on the part of Russian Emigrants
Committee.

(d) Public Dining Room is property of the emigrant community.
It has been ascertained from local representative of the Russian
Orthodox Mission, that the Letter of Trust referred to by N.U.
FOMIN, was issued by the Mission in respect of the land only. It
was also ascertained from the same source that the Mission has no
objection whatsoever to the handing of the property for use by
the R.E.Committee for charity purposes,as requested.

俄罗斯东正教在华传教团。该传教团团长、大主教维克多（北京）就相关财产向中央委员会主席 N.U.福明（N.U.FOMIN）及该传教团当地代表 M.罗戈任神父（Father M.ROGOJIN）签发了信托书。

(e) 俄侨委员会主席 F.L.格列博夫（F.L.GLEBOFF）命令 N.U.福明将公共食堂移交给新成立的“特别经济委员会”，并解散中央委员会。他要求 N.U.福明个人负责执行此命令。然而，N.U.福明作为受托人之一，在未获得委托人维克多大主教授权的情况下，无权移交传教团的财产。此外，他在以中央委员会主席身份依法厘清其手头所有债务和义务之前，亦无权解散中央委员会。

(f) 解散中央委员会将意味着该组织开展的广泛慈善工作中断；丧失每月约 1,000,000 元用于侨民社区慈善事业的收入，这笔款项目前系由中央委员会努力赚取；此外，这将导致中央委员会目前的约 50 名雇员和约 100 名受救济人员立即陷入困境。

II. 俄侨委员会的观点，
主席 F.L.格列博夫。

(a) 根据 1941 年 11 月 9 日大上海市长批准的《俄侨委员会章程》，俄侨委员会是一个行政机构，所有居住在上海的俄国侨民及其所有组织均隶属于该委员会。俄侨委员会主席指导其活动并对此负责。

(b) 随着该章程的公布，关于成立中央慈善委员会的 1941 年 6 月 11 日议定书已失去约束力。

(c) 虽然章程中未提及俄侨委员会架构中的慈善部门，但第 9 条规定，侨民社区的所有慈善活动均须受俄侨委员会的控制。

(d) 公共食堂属于侨民社区的财产。经从俄罗斯东正教传教团当地代表处核实，N.U.福明所提及的信托书仅涉及土地。另从同一来源获悉，传教团对按要求将该财产移交给俄侨委员会用于慈善目的没有任何异议。

(e) The matter of liabilities and obligations, which N.U.FO-
MIN may have on hand in his capacity of Chairman of Central Chari-
ty Committee, is subject to consideration and regulation by the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee and N.U. FOMIN, and by no means can delay
or obstruct immediate handing over of Public Dining Hut for tempo-
rary use by Special Economic Council.

(f) The Central Charity Committee first evaded and then flat-
ly refused to give full account of its activities and to put it-
self under public control - a very natural demand in public life.
Following formation of Special Economic Council, which was mainly
due to inactivity of the Central Charity Committee, for very urgent
task of organization of food supply to the poorer classes of the
emigrant community, the C.C.Committee on purely formal grounds de-
layed the handing over of the Public Dining Hut to the Special Eco-
nomic Council. Thus, activities of a small group of individuals com-
prising the C.C.Committee and claiming full independence in their
activities, have reached the stage of open insubordination to the
Emigrants Committee and its Chairman, which state of affairs is con-
trary to the Statute of the R.E.Committee and cannot be tolerated
any longer.

In outlining details of the dispute under consideration, every-
thing that savoured of personal antagonism was ignored. That per-
sonal antagonism may have something to do with this dispute is evi-
denced by general tone of Mr. FOMIN's complaint and especially by
the outburst against Mr. GLEBOFF, contained in Clause 10 of the com-
plaint. In order to obtain a correct view of this point and in
fairness to Mr. GLEBOFF it should be noted that he was elected to
the post of Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee in 1942 by ma-
jority of 129 against 3 of representatives of emigrant organizations;
in 1943 he was re-elected unanimously by about 160 representatives
of organizations. On both occasions the Central Charity Committee
had 14 votes.

Towards the end of 1944 some criticism was voiced of Mr. GLE-
BOFF's activities as Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee.
Therefore, for the first time in the history of the local Russian
emigrant community, elections were arranged on December 24 and 25,
1944, in which every Russian emigrant duly registered with the R.E.
Committee, who had his passport in proper order and participated
in contributions towards the voluntary Self-Taxation Fund of the
community, was called upon to participate. Mr. GLEBOFF was elected
having secured twice as many votes, as Mr. N.U. FOMIN, the only
other candidate.(4)

It should also be noted that Mr. N.U. FOMIN, a prominent pub-
lic worker in the emigrant community, was a party to every
strife that has taken place within the community over the question
of administration of the community. Naturally, he is to a certain
extent responsible for inability to reach an understanding in this
matter.

(e) N.U.福明在以中央慈善委员会主席身份可能手头上存在的债务和义务问题，应由俄侨委员会和 N.U.福明予以审议和处理，绝不能因此延误或阻碍立即将公共食堂移交给特别经济委员会临时使用。

(f) 中央慈善委员会先是回避，随后断然拒绝全面汇报其工作并接受公众监督——这是公共生活中非常自然的要求。特别经济委员会的成立，主要是由于中央慈善委员会在组织向侨民社区贫困阶层供应粮食这一紧迫任务上的不作为，而中央委员会却以纯粹形式上的理由拖延将公共食堂移交给特别经济委员会。因此，由组成中央委员会的一小群人开展的活动，以及他们声称在其活动中拥有完全独立性的做法，已达到公然不服从俄侨委员会及其主席的地步，这种状况违反了《俄侨委员会章程》，不能再被容忍。

在概述正在审议的纠纷细节时，任何带有个人敌意的内容均被忽略。个人敌意可能与此次纠纷有关，这一点从福明先生投诉书的总体基调，特别是投诉书第 10 条中对格列博夫先生的激烈抨击中可以看出来。为了正确看待这一点并公平对待格列博夫先生，应当指出，他在 1942 年由侨民组织代表以 129 票对 3 票的多数当选为俄侨委员会主席；1943 年，他在约 160 名组织代表的投票中一致获得连任。在这两次选举中，中央慈善委员会均拥有 14 张选票。

1944 年底，有人对格列博夫先生作为俄侨委员会主席的活动提出批评。因此，在当地俄侨社区历史上首次于 1944 年 12 月 24 日和 25 日安排了选举，凡是在俄侨委员会正式登记、护照手续齐全并参与了社区自愿自税基金捐款的每一位俄国侨民，均被号召参加。格列博夫先生当选，其得票数是唯一另一位候选人 N.U.福明先生的两倍。(4)

还应注意，N.U.福明先生是侨民社区中一位杰出的社会活动家，参与了社区内发生的每一次关于社区管理问题的纷争。自然，他对在此事上未能达成谅解负有一定责任。

page_data.en:
-2-

In conclusion of this report I have to state that on
13-4-45 representatives of the Russian Emigrants Committee headed
by Mr. G.K. BOLOGOFF, acting on instructions of Chairman of the
Committee and being in possession of a document from local repre-
sentative of the Russian Orthodox Mission to the effect that the
Mission had no objection to the handing over of the hut, arrived
at the premises 79/A Route de Say Zoong and demanded handing over
of the Public Dining Hut to the Russian Emigrants Committee.
Mr. N.U. FOMIN protested to the police authorities, Zang-
Zau Police Station. Being unsuccessful in this, he had to come to
terms with representatives of the R.E. Committee and agreement
was signed by the parties concerned to the effect that

(a) Mr. N.U. FOMIN, Chairman of the former Central Charity
Committee, will, for the purpose of effecting technical procedure
of handing over of documents and property of the former C.C. Com-
mittee, will appoint manually Over Commission of 5 members, who were
to come to the premises of the Public Dining Hut on 16-4-45, arm-
ed with proper powers.

(b) Joint Commission for receiving and handing over, un-
der chairmanship of M.A. MOSHKIN, will consider liabilities of
the former C.C. Committee in respect of third parties with a view
to the ascertaining their legality and with a view to the meeting
of these liabilities.

(c) The Joint Commission is to carry its work not later
than 1-5-45.

Mr. N. FOMIN signed this agreement with the following re-
marks:
(a) "I do not consider as quite legal the document issued
by the Russian Orthodox Mission in China, as it does
not bear the signature of Archbishop Victor who signed the
Letter of Trust issued in my name.

(b) I am obliged to sign this act yielding to the fact
of forcible occupation of the premises, it being impos-
sible for me to obtain protection".

Activities of the Public Dining Hut and of other branches
of the former Central Charity Committee have since been carried
on without any disruption under supervision of Mr. G.K. BOLOGOFF,
the newly appointed Acting Chief of Charity Section of the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee, Mr. N.U. FOMIN having been relieved
of this post by order of Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee
dated 10-4-45.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs
Section.

A. Prokofieff
A/C.D.I.

在本报告结尾，我必须陈述，1945 年 4 月 13 日，俄侨委员会代表在 G.K.博洛戈夫（G.K.BOLOGOFF）带领下，按照委员会主席的指示，并持有俄罗斯东正教传教团当地代表出具的一份文件，表明传教团对移交该食堂无异议，他们抵达赛宗路（Route de Say Zoong）79/A 号 premises，要求将公共食堂移交给俄侨委员会。
N.U.福明先生向警察当局，即闸北警察局提出抗议。由于此举未果，他不得不与俄侨委员会代表达成妥协，有关各方签署协议，内容如下：

(a) 前中央慈善委员会主席 N.U.福明先生，为了完成移交前中央委员会文件和财产的技术程序，将手动任命一个由 5 名成员组成的交接委员会，该委员会将于 1945 年 4 月 16 日携带适当授权前往公共食堂所在地。

(b) 在 M.A.莫什金（M.A.MOSHKIN）主持下，接收和移交联合委员会将审议前中央委员会对第三方的债务，以确定其合法性并着手清偿这些债务。

(c) 联合委员会的工作至迟应于 1945 年 5 月 1 日前完成。

N.福明先生在签署此协议时附加了以下备注：
(a) “我认为俄罗斯东正教在华传教团出具的文件并不完全合法，因为它没有签署以我名义签发信托书的维克多大主教的签名。

(b) 我被迫签署此文件，是因为 premises 被强行占领，而我无法获得保护”。

此后，公共食堂及前中央慈善委员会其他分支的活动在俄侨委员会新任慈善科代理科长 G.K.博洛戈夫先生的监督下继续进行，未受任何中断，N.U.福明先生已根据俄侨委员会主席 1945 年 4 月 10 日的命令被免去该职务。

外事科主管警官

A.普罗科菲耶夫（A. Prokofieff）
助理副督察长

Shanghai, March 16, 1945.

MEMORANDUM

on the subject of difficulties experienced by
Central Charity Committee of Russian Emigrant
Community in Shanghai

1. The Central Charity Committee was established on June 11, 1943
by virtue of a special protocol signed by three parties, namely:
(a) Archbishop Victor, head of Russian Orthodox Mis-
sion in China, and Bishop John of Shanghai;
(b) N.U. Fomin, Chairman, and members of National Com-
mittee of Russian Emigrants Association and
(c) N.A. Ivanoff, Chairman of Russian Emigrants Commit-
tee, officially appointed to his post by Mayor of
Greater Shanghai.
By the same act the National Committee of Russian Emigrants Asso-
ciation was abolished, and all its rights and property were hand-
ed over to the newly established Central Charity Committee, while
Chairman and members of the National Committee of Russian Emi-
grants Association were automatically included in the newly es-
tablished Central Charity Committee retaining their respective
posts. The same protocol provides " economic, financial and pro-
perty independence of the Central Charity Committee and its re-
gistration with the Russian Emigrants Committee as an independent
organization on common basis.

2. The Central Charity Committee was subsequently lawfully regist-
ered with the Russian Emigrants Committee, as well as with all
proper authorities and the police, including the present Shanghai
Municipal Council.

3. The Central Charity Committee is located at No 79-A Route de Say-
zoong ( Charng Shu Lu ), in own house belonging to the Russian Or-
thodox Mission in China.. Archbishop Victor, head of the Russian
Orthodox Mission in China, gave full power of attorney for pos-
session of the piece of land and houses situated on it to Messrs
N.U. Fomin, Chairman of the Central Charity Committee, and Father
Mihail Rogojin, archpriest, representative of the Mission's Council
in Shanghai.

4. The Statute of Russian Emigrants Committee approved by Mayor of
Greater Shanghai on November 8, 1941 does not provide for Charity
Section, as upon report of N.A. Ivanoff, then chairman of the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee, duties of Charity Section are incumbent
on N.U. Fomin, Chairman of Central Charity Committee, and have
since been performed gratis. Apart from attending in a general
way to combined Russian charities in Shanghai, the main attention
of the Central Charity Committee was directed towards the task
of providing needy Russian emigrants with shelter and food free
of charge or at reduced price. For this purpose was, as far back
as 1937, created the Public Dining Hut, located at 79-A Route de
Sayzoong ( Charng Shu Lu ), which is still functioning. The main
sources of income of the Central Charity Committee are:-
(a) Proceeds from the game of Lotto permitted and
controlled by the police;
(b) Proceeds from exploitation of the premises and
(c) Other charity sources, including an insignificant
monetary subsidy from the Russian Emigrants Com-
mittee.

上海，1945年3月16日。

备忘录

关于上海俄国侨民中央慈善委员会所遇困难事宜

1. 中央慈善委员会于1943年6月11日成立，依据是由三方签署的一项特别议定书，即：
(a) 中国东正教传教团团长维克多（Victor）大主教及上海区主教约翰（John）；
(b) 俄国侨民协会全国委员会主席N.U. Fomin先生及其成员；以及
(c) 俄国侨民委员会主席N.A. Ivanoff先生，其职位由大上海市长正式任命。
根据同一文件，俄国侨民协会全国委员会被撤销，其所有权利和财产移交给新成立的中央慈善委员会，而俄国侨民协会全国委员会的主席和成员自动并入新成立的中央慈善委员会，并保留各自职务。该议定书还规定“中央慈善委员会在经济、财务和财产方面的独立性，并将其作为独立组织在俄国侨民委员会进行常规注册”。

2. 随后，中央慈善委员会依法在俄国侨民委员会以及所有相关当局和警方（包括现任上海公共租界工部局）进行了注册。

3. 中央慈善委员会位于霞飞路79-A号（常熟路），房产属于中国东正教传教团。中国东正教传教团团长维克多大主教授予中央慈善委员会主席N.U. Fomin先生及传教团理事会驻上海代表、首席司祭米哈伊尔·罗戈津（Mihail Rogojin）神父全权委托书，以占有该地块及其上的房屋。

4. 大上海市长于1941年11月8日批准的《俄国侨民委员会章程》中未设慈善科，因为据时任俄国侨民委员会主席N.A. Ivanoff报告，慈善科的职责由中央慈善委员会主席N.U. Fomin承担，且此后一直无偿履行。除了总体关照上海联合俄国慈善事业外，中央慈善委员会的主要精力集中于为贫困俄国侨民提供免费或低价食宿的任务。为此，早在1937年就建立了位于霞飞路79-A号（常熟路）的公共食堂，目前仍在运作。中央慈善委员会的主要收入来源为：
(a) 经警方许可并监管的乐透彩票（Lotto）收益；
(b) 房产经营收益；以及
(c) 其他慈善来源，包括来自俄国侨民委员会的一笔微薄货币补贴。

- 2 -

Statements of accounts re: receipts and expenditures of the Central
Charity Committee are sent monthly to the Police headquarters, Yang-
zau Police Station, as well as to the Russian Emigrants Committee.
Especially detailed statements or accounts are submitted regarding
Lotto, which contain the following data; gross receipts on each day,
the game is operated, expenses in connection with operating the game,
number of patrons attending, net profit and particulars as to its
distribution. Very often proceeds from Lotto were directed for the
benefit of other charitable organizations requiring help, such as
orphanages, schools etc.

5. Budget of the Central Charity Committee for the year 1944 reached
the sum of over $15,000,000, while at present the Central Charity
Committee spends over $1,000,000 per month solely on charity.

6. Under Mr. Gleboff's predecessors at the post of Chairman of Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee the work of the Central Charity Committee
was carried out normally and with great success. From the moment
of Mr. Gleboff's coming to power the Central Charity Committee be-
gan to experience a series of difficulties, and relations became es-
pecially tense after Mr. N.U. Fomin, Chairman of the Central Charity
Committee, stood for election to the post of Chairman of Russian
Emigrants Committee in December 1944. At the present time, as will
be seen from what is set forth below.

7. Taking into consideration extremely serious food situation which
prevailed in the town and being aware of the difficult position of
all Russian charitable organizations the Central Charity Committee,
as far back as summer, 1944, raised the question of obtaining a
large loan from the Central Reserve Bank with the said piece of land
as security,, with a view to the buying of foodstuffs and creation
of a central storehouse for supplying needy population with cheap
products. This plan failed because the Russian Bank in Shanghai
demanded a too large commission for negotiation of the loan.
On January 11, 1945 this question was again raised by the Central
Charity Committee in the Russian Emigrants Committee and was for the
second time rejected by Mr. Gleboff. Instead of this plan of the
Central Charity Committee conceived a scheme of raising up to 50
million dollars by compulsory means. After this scheme had been
frustrated, because Gleboff's action was inconsistent with law and
was taken without previous consultation with the Russian Chamber
of Commerce, by method of intimidation only, he directed his efforts
towards seizure of property of the Central Charity Committee under
the pretext of utilizing its Public Dining hut as a food distribu-
tion point. true
At first, when Gleboff's intentions were not clear, his undertakings
were met halfway by the Central Charity Committee and on February 18,
1945 representatives of the Central Charity Committee signed an ag-
reement with representatives of the Special Economic Council regard-
ing handing over of the major part of premises of the Public Dining
hut for temporary use free of charge for the purpose stated above.
The Central Charity Committee also offered to hand over in future
those parts of of proceeds from Lotto which are usually spent on
free meals. The generous offer of the Central Charity Committee
failed to satisfy Gleboff and he demanded immediate abolition of
the Central Charity Committee, having made N.U. Fomin, Chairman of
the Committee, personally responsible for this abolition, while N.U.
Fomin was offered the post of Chief of Charity Section of the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee, which post does not exist at all, according
to the Statute of Russian Emigrants Committee approved by Mayor of
Greater Shanghai.

9. Inconsistency of this order with law will be seen from the follow-
ing:-
Mr. N.U. Fomin, in his capacity of a trustee of the Russian Orthodox
Mission in China, has no right to hand over into full actual posses-
sion of a third and even unregistered organization ( Special Econo-
mic Council ) without the consent of the truster - Archbishop
Victor. Mr. N.U. Fomin, in his capacity of Chairman of Central Cha-
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

中央慈善委员会的收支账目报表每月报送至警察总局、杨树浦警察局以及俄国侨民委员会。特别是关于乐透彩票的详细报表或账目，包含以下数据：运营期间的每日总收入、运营相关支出、参与人数、净利润及其分配详情。乐透彩票的收益经常用于援助其他需要帮助的慈善组织，如孤儿院、学校等。

5. 中央慈善委员会1944年度的预算达到15,000,000元以上，而目前中央慈善委员会仅用于慈善事业的月支出就超过1,000,000元。

6. 在Gleboff先生前任担任俄国侨民委员会主席期间，中央慈善委员会的工作正常开展并取得巨大成功。自Gleboff先生掌权以来，中央慈善委员会开始遭遇一系列困难，而在中央慈善委员会主席N.U. Fomin先生于1944年12月竞选俄国侨民委员会主席一职后，关系变得尤为紧张。目前的情况，如下文所述。

7. 考虑到市内极其严峻的粮食状况，并意识到所有俄国慈善组织面临的困境，中央慈善委员会早在1944年夏季就提出以上述土地为抵押，向中央储备银行申请大额贷款，旨在购买食品并建立中心仓库，以向贫困人群提供廉价产品。该计划未能实现，因为上海的俄国银行要求过高的贷款谈判佣金。
1945年1月11日，中央慈善委员会再次在俄国侨民委员会提出此问题，但第二次遭到Gleboff先生拒绝。取而代之的是，中央慈善委员会构思了一项通过强制手段筹集高达5,000万美元的方案。由于Gleboff先生的行动不符合法律，且未经事先与俄国商会协商，仅通过恐吓手段致使该方案受挫后，他便以利用公共食堂作为食品分发点为借口，致力于夺取中央慈善委员会的财产。
起初，当Gleboff的意图尚不明确时，中央慈善委员会对其要求做出了让步，1945年2月18日，中央慈善委员会代表与特别经济委员会代表签署协议，将公共食堂的大部分场所无偿临时移交，用于上述目的。中央慈善委员会还提议将来移交通常用于免费餐食的那部分乐透彩票收益。中央慈善委员会的慷慨提议未能满足Gleboff，他要求立即撤销中央慈善委员会，并使委员会主席N.U. Fomin个人对此撤销负责，同时向N.U. Fomin提供俄国侨民委员会慈善科科长的职位，而根据大上海市长批准的《俄国侨民委员会章程》，该职位根本不存在。

9. 此项命令与法律的不一致之处可见于以下几点：
N.U. Fomin先生作为中国东正教传教团的受托人，未经委托人维克多大主教同意，无权将财产完全实际移交给第三方甚至未注册的组织（特别经济委员会）。N.U. Fomin先生作为中央慈善委

page_data.en:
- 3 -

rity Committee, and in the name of the latter has on hand a number of financial and material obligations to third parties, and thus an abolition of the Central Charity Committee without a lawful liquidation of all these economic relations is liable to cause a series of financial claims to the Central Charity Committee on the part of employees (numbering 51), as well as on the part of the various contractors. As the Central Charity Committee has no free capital and, consequently, in the event of liquidation capitalization of the property will become inevitable, the property in question cannot be put at the disposal of the Special Economic Council. Mr. N.U. Fomin and Governing Board of the Committee refused to comply with this order pending arrival in Shanghai of Archbishop Victor.

9.
As a result of this refusal there followed repressions on the part of Mr. Gleboff and Russian Emigrants Committee, which took the shape of a complaint, addressed to Mr. Matsushita, Deputy Chief of Zangzau Police Station, against the Central Charity Committee for disobedience to the order of Chairman of Russian Emigrants Committee. Mr. Matsushita adopted formal viewpoint and intended to withdraw permission for operating Lotto in the Public Dining hut, and it was only after insistent requests of Mr. Chairman of Central Charity Committee and after explanations, supported by documents, of inconsistency with law of Mr. Gleboff's actions that he agreed to the continuing of Lotto for an unspecified brief period pending a documentary protest, which the Central Charity Committee was to direct to the Russian Emigrants Committee.

10.
The position of Central Charity Committee has been becoming especially difficult for some time past as, apart from unlawful persecutions, the collaboration itself with Mr. Gleboff, has become absolutely impossible from the viewpoint of ethics, as Russian Public workers comprising the Central Charity Committee and having stainless reputation of honest, loyal citizens of Shanghai cannot recognize, as their head and representative before the Authorities, a man concerned in the creation of a criminal gambling den, which was exposed by the police and which is commented upon in all local newspapers. These circumstances exhaust one's patience, as Gleboff's activities in administrating the community was in many cases before already marked with a character inconsistent with law infringing the Statute of Russian Emigrants Committee, approved by Mayor of Greater Shanghai on November 8 1945.

11.
In the event of abolition of the Central Charity Committee in accordance with Gleboff's plan, immediate catastrophe will be experienced by 51 employees and over 100 people, receiving meals and other relief from the Central Charity Committee, while combined budget of charitable organizations will be less of a sum over 1,000,000 dollars, which is earned by the Central Charity Committee solely by its own efforts, without applying for any help to private people or to institutions.

9.
由于这一拒绝，Gleboff先生及俄国侨民委员会实施了镇压，表现为向杨树浦警察局副局长松田（Matsushita）先生提出申诉，指控中央慈善委员会不服从俄国侨民委员会主席的命令。松田先生采取形式主义观点，打算撤销在公共食堂运营乐透彩票的许可，只是在中央慈善委员会主席的坚决请求下，并在有文件支持的解释说明Gleboff先生行动违法之后，他才同意在中央慈善委员会向俄国侨民委员会提交书面抗议期间，暂时继续运营乐透彩票一段不确定的短暂时间。

10.
近段时间以来，中央慈善委员会的处境变得尤为艰难，因为除了非法迫害外，从道德角度来看，与Gleboff先生的合作已完全不可能，因为组成中央慈善委员会的俄国公共事务工作者享有上海诚实、忠诚公民的良好声誉，他们无法承认一个涉嫌创建被警方揭露且被当地所有报纸评论的犯罪赌博窝点的人为其首领及在当局面前的代表。这些情况令人忍无可耐，因为Gleboff先生在管理社区方面的活动在许多情况下此前就已表现出违反1945年11月8日大上海市长批准的《俄国侨民委员会章程》的违法特征。（注：原文日期为1945年，前文提及批准日期为1941年，此处照实翻译）

11.
如果按照Gleboff的计划撤销中央慈善委员会，51名员工和100多名从中央慈善委员会获得餐食及其他救济的人员将立即陷入灾难，而各慈善组织的联合预算将减少超过1,000,000元的金额，这笔钱完全是中央慈善委员会凭自身努力赚取的，未向任何个人或机构寻求帮助。
